decision_rule: 9/10 TRAIN quarters vs volume-matched control AND total R positive AND recovery factor >= 1.5. Predicted effect is deliberately BELOW the sum of its arms: the slot cap binds 51% of cycles, so volume-reducing changes are sub-additive.
hypothesis: A score built only from components with measured information, gated on FVG and re-anchored to constant admitted volume, beats 2.2.0 scoring.
